release_notes: City Island request shortcut: press backslash while playing MOOR City inside COLONY.
COLONY captures a fresh MOOR City render and opens a standardized screenshot + text request tab.
Submitted requests are stored in IndexedDB with the screenshot Blob and are also routed into MOOR City Continuity/update context.
The shortcut ignores backslash while typing in inputs, textareas, selects, or editable text.
